slides.title: You didn't fail your routine. You're missing a restart protocol.
Every routine breaks
slides.body: Sick week, travel, busy month, bad brain days. The routine was never going to last forever. Plan for the break.

slides.title: Don't wait for Monday
slides.body: Restart the next meal, not the next week. Waiting for a fresh start gives the mess 6 more days.

slides.title: Restart smaller than before
slides.body: Only the Daily 3, or only one of them. Rebuild from the smallest version, then add back.

slides.title: Do the emergency reset first
slides.body: 15 minutes, visible surfaces only. It clears the 'where do I even start' fog.

slides.title: No catching up
slides.body: Don't try to do every missed day. Start from today. The backlog shrinks on its own when the routine runs.

slides.title: Falling off isn't the problem. Staying off because of shame is.
Get the full restart protocol
slides.body: The step-by-step restart protocol is in The Messy Brain Home Reset. Link in bio.
